# Drive documentation sources

Map between Google Drive originals and digital knowledge-base pages.

## Keep these (latest)

| Keep in Drive | Digital page | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| User Guide Milinav Application.pdf | [User Guide](#/user-guide) | Latest English end-user manual |
| Technical User Guide Milinav Application.pdf | [Technical Guide](#/technical-guide) | Latest technical manual + encryption |
| Procedure for Converting TIFF to MMPK Using ArcGIS Pro.pdf | [TIFF to MMPK](#/tiff-to-mmpk) | Raster → MMPK packaging |
| Panduan Ringkas Aplikasi Milinav.docx | [Panduan Ringkas](#/panduan-ringkas) | Bahasa Melayu quick guide |
| 7zip_window_configuration.png | Embedded in Technical Guide / Storage Paths | ZIP packaging screenshot |
| ADB / USB DOCX set | Device Ops pages | Unique device procedures |

## How this portal is organized

1. **Application Manuals** — User, Technical, Panduan, TIFF→MMPK
2. **Device Ops** — ADB, kiosk ownership, USB modes (with workflow diagrams)
3. **TacMap** — [complete guide](#/tacmap), feature list, path clearance, bearing, billing, storage

[Open the shared Drive folder](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1fVt7Zf1XkKXcgnX1Ts-Bj9pSUhujavHP)

## Also in this portal

- [Spatial Mesh & LoRa](#/spatial-mesh-lora) — plugin setup, channel vs private DM, and how packets travel on the mesh (from `develop` / `docs/SPATIAL_MESH.md`).
